title.zh: 修订第328号共和国法第86条（即Calbayog市 Charter）的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Section Eighty-Six of Republic Act Numbered Three Hundred Twenty-Eight, Otherwise Known as the Charter of the City of Calbayog
title.orig: An Act Amending Section Eighty-Six of Republic Act Numbered Three Hundred Twenty-Eight, Otherwise Known as the Charter of the City of Calbayog

text.en:
Section eighty-six of Republic Act Numbered Three hundred twenty-eight, otherwise known as the Charter of the City of Calbayog, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 86. The Bureau of Public Schools. -The Director of Public Schools shall exercise the same jurisdiction and powers in the city as elsewhere in the Philippines and the Division Superintendent of Schools for the Province of Samar, shall act as ex officio City Superintendent of Schools of the City of Calbayog with additional compensation at the rate of eight hundred pesos per annum payable from the funds of the city. He shall have all the powers and duties in respect to the schools of the city as are vested in the division superintendents in respect to schools of their division."

This Act shall take effect on July one, nineteen hundred fifty-two.
Approved: June 14, 1956.
